ad_library.summary: Dakshin Solar Power Systems is running 1 active Meta ad, started 16 October 2026 - a generic awareness ad whose click opens a WhatsApp chat rather than dakshinsolar.com. The site itself is detailed and specific (TOPCon panels, Polycab/Growatt inverters, an 8-component turnkey list with warranties, a completed-projects grid), none of which the paid click ever sees. No Google Ads advertiser record was checked for this report - that requires the full pipeline.

funnel.meaning: The click opens a chat, not dakshinsolar.com. There is no page you own, no form that captures the enquiry in writing, no pixel, and no way to retarget everyone who started a chat and never replied.

findings: The single live ad routes to WhatsApp - the site's full component breakdown (TOPCon panels, Polycab/Growatt inverters, DCDB/ACDB boxes, elevated galvanised structures, MC4 connectors, lightning arrestor, chemical earthing pits) never gets seen by the click.

The site's strongest asset - 'What's Included in Your Solar System', an 8-component turnkey list with a 30-year panel warranty, 10-year inverter warranty and 5-year free service - is not reflected anywhere in the ad copy.
One ad, one generic angle, live since 16 Oct. There is no subsidy creative even though the site leads with PM Surya Ghar (up to Rs. 78,000) and a 'Subsidy Scheme Ends 31st March 2027' countdown.

The homepage's stat block (panel warranty, inverter warranty, free service, savings %, satisfaction %) ships as '0 Yrs' and '0%' in the page source and depends on script animation to fill in - if the animation does not run for a visitor, the page argues against itself. Worth verifying on a real phone.

The completed-projects grid (residential and commercial installs across Hyderabad and Telangana) is exactly the proof a WhatsApp-clicking homeowner asks for next - and it is one tap further away than it needs to be.
next_steps: Send the ad to a page you own
Point the ad at a Dakshin landing page with the TOPCon + warranty story, a quote form and the Meta Pixel, and keep WhatsApp as the second click - not the first.
Run the subsidy angle you already sell
The site's PM Surya Ghar Rs. 78,000 section and the 31 March 2027 deadline are a ready-made second creative with real urgency behind it.
Put the 8-component list in front of the click
Panels, inverter, structures, cables, connectors, arrestor, earthing - that list is the answer to 'what am I actually paying for'. It belongs on the landing page.
Make the warranty and savings numbers render as real values in the HTML so no visitor - or no slow connection - ever sees 0 Yrs / 0%.
